This enemy has a higher All-Attribute RES.
This enemy has the Rage Feather ability and three weaknesses. After remaining in combat for a period of time, Kronaclaw enters the Rage Feather state, greatly enhancing its ATK.
Weakness I: A successful Counterattack can damage its crest and wings, weakening its attacks and reducing the number of ranged projectiles.
Weakness II: Tune Break can remove its Rage Feather state and reduce its ranged projectiles.
Special Weakness: When Kronaclaw is under Tune Rupture - Shifting, hitting it with Tune Break will greatly reduce its All-Attribute RES. An extinct ancient raptor reproduced through the Upphaff Life Chamber.
In the distant past, these raptors once circled the skies of Lahai-Roi, their dominion unchallenged since the First Epoch.
Legend holds that the Kronaclaw was a creation of Sol, sharing the divine sight of the Eye of Sol and beholding all that lay above and below Lahai-Roi.
But as magnetic poles shifted and the landscape was reshaped, the Kronaclaw species had faded into near extinction. Their place was eventually taken by Kronablight, an Exoswarm born of the Exostrider.|Description When Discovered}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Kronaclaw |zhs = 冠顶苍隼 |zht = 冠頂蒼隼 |ja = クロナファルコン |ko = 크로나클라우 |fr = Griffouronne |de = Kronaklaue |es = Kronáguila |th = Kronaclaw }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.1}} ==Navigation== {{Enemy Navbox}}
